## What We Do
Ascent Group Construction is a specialty contractor focused on building envelope and restoration services. We serve as a prime contractor for commercial projects and provide quality services for residential clients. We self-perform 85% of our work, ensuring direct quality control and accountability.

### Primary Services
1. Building Envelope Solutions - Complete envelope systems for new and existing buildings
2. Façade Remediation - Repair and restoration of building exteriors
3. Waterproofing Systems - Foundation, below-grade, and parking garage waterproofing
4. EIFS & Stucco Systems - Installation and repair of exterior insulation finish systems
5. Masonry Restoration - Brick, block, and stone repair and replacement
6. Cladding Systems - Metal, composite, and panel cladding installation
7. Parking Garage Restoration - Concrete repair, waterproofing, and traffic coatings
8. Protective & Architectural Coatings - Commercial and industrial coating systems
9. Commercial Painting - Interior and exterior painting for all building types
10. Interior Finishing - Drywall, taping, and interior buildout work
11. Tile & Flooring - Commercial and residential tile installation

## Who We Serve
- General Contractors (as a reliable trade partner)
- Property Managers (building maintenance and restoration)
- Developers (new construction envelope work)
- Commercial Building Owners (repairs and maintenance)
- Homeowners (residential exterior and interior services)

## Why Choose Us
- 85% of work is self-performed (quality control)
- 15+ years of combined crew experience
- WSIB compliant with $2M Commercial General Liability
- Full project management from assessment to completion
- Responsive communication and detailed documentation
- 48-hour quote turnaround for standard packages
- Pilot projects welcome for new GC relationships

## Service Areas
Primary: Toronto, North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill
Extended: Oakville, Burlington, Hamilton, and throughout Ontario

## Credentials
- WSIB Clearance Certificate (Active)
- $2,000,000 Commercial General Liability Insurance
- Construction Engineering background (George Brown College)

## Founder Background
Hebun Isik founded Ascent Group Construction after graduating from George Brown College's Construction Engineering Technology program. The company was established to fill the need for a reliable, quality-focused specialty contractor in the Ontario market.

## Key Differentiators
1. Self-Performed Work: Unlike many contractors who subcontract, we perform 85% of work with our own trained crews
2. Specialty Focus: We specialize in building envelope rather than being a general contractor
3. Trade Partner: We work collaboratively with GCs rather than competing with them
4. Quality Documentation: Daily reports, progress photos, and detailed closeout packages
5. Responsive: 48-hour quote turnaround, 24-hour RFI response

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What areas does Ascent Group Construction serve?
A: We serve the entire Greater Toronto Area including Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, and across Ontario.

Q: What types of projects does Ascent specialize in?
A: We specialize in building envelope and restoration work including façade remediation, parking garage restoration, EIFS repair, masonry restoration, and waterproofing for commercial, multi-family, and institutional projects.

Q: Is Ascent Group Construction licensed and insured?
A: Yes, we are fully WSIB compliant and carry $2M commercial general liability insurance coverage.

Q: Does Ascent use subcontractors?
A: For our core envelope and restoration services, we self-perform 85% of the work with our trained crews rather than using subcontractors. This ensures quality control and accountability.

Q: Do you work with general contractors?
A: Yes, we serve as a reliable trade partner for general contractors, providing envelope and interior trade packages. We offer competitive unit rates and 48-hour quote turnaround.

Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: We provide complimentary site assessments for commercial projects and estimates for all work. Contact us at 647-528-6804 to schedule.
